## Definition of Done Checklist

- [ ] Linked issue(s) are included, or `No issue needed` is justified.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passed.
- [ ] `npm run type-check` passed.
- [ ] `npm test` passed.
- [ ] `npm run build:prod` passed.
- [ ] Tests were added/updated or rationale provided.
- [ ] Performance impact note is included (`no impact` or measured impact with method).
- [ ] Contract/schema changes are documented (worker messages, device interfaces, fixtures/recordings).
- [ ] If telemetry or diagnostics changed, privacy review completed:
  - Checklist: `docs/telemetry/privacy-review-checklist.md`
  - Data contract: `docs/telemetry/telemetry-data-contract.md`
- [ ] ADR created/updated if decision is architectural and hard to reverse.
- [ ] Docs updated for behavior/workflow changes.
- [ ] Vertical slice impact confirmed (`docs/process/mvp-cutline-and-sequencing.md`).
